question: Who among the following was specifically set up to look after the military organisation of the Delhi Sultanate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**diwan-e-arz**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **diwan-e-arz** was a department established during the Delhi Sultanate specifically to manage the military administration.
 
• The head of this department was known as the **Ariz-i-Mumalik** who was responsible for the recruitment, training, and maintenance of the army.
 
• This department ensured proper salaries and logistics for the soldiers, as well as maintained a detailed record of the military personnel.
 
• It played a crucial role in maintaining the strength and readiness of the Sultanate's military forces for defense and expansion.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Diwan-e-Qada**

 
 
• This department was responsible for administering justice and legal matters within the Sultanate.
 
• The chief judge of this department was called the **Qazi**.
 
 
 
• **Diwan-e-Insha**
 
 
• This department handled the royal correspondence and state communications.
 
• The head of this department was known as the **Dabir**.
 
 
 
• **Diwan-e-Vizarat**
 
 
• This department was responsible for the financial administration of the Sultanate.
 
• The head of this department was the **Wazir**, who managed revenue collection and expenditure.
 
 
 
• **Ariz-i-Mumalik**
 
 
• The title given to the head of the Diwan-e-Arz.
 
• He was instrumental in ensuring that the army was well-maintained, disciplined, and ready for battle.
